researched: 2026-11-19 (launch day). Guides are written for this app in its own words; every fact is tied to the sources listed beside it.

stages.title: Story, chapters 1–5
stages.summary: Play the five chapters. Story trophies pop on their own. Take every side questline as it is offered and scan vehicles and animals while you travel; progress already counts toward 100%.
musts: Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (the one possibly missable trophy)
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay
Never turn on cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving

stages.title: Side questlines as they open
stages.summary: Kenton (Ch1), Cal's fishing, Billy, Bret and the garages (Ch2), Andy, Randy, Tyrone and Yasmani's robberies (Ch3), bank vaults (Ch4 optional mission). All stay open after the credits, so none of them can lock you out.
musts: After Coffee Break (Ch2) the partner trophies open: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best
Buy garages from the Vice City Real Estate app once Daily Driver (Ch2) is done

stages.title: 100% checklist in free-roam
stages.summary: The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient (about 60% of true completion), but robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, underwater finds and Bret's decks are needed in full. Most activity and collectible trophies fall out of it.
musts: 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, 30 unique race wins, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied

stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up
stages.summary: Strangers & Freaks strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so finish eight of them now, then sweep up feats such as the tank, the airport jet and the showroom escape.
musts: Check the trophy tracker in the PlayStation list for anything with a counter

stages.title: Platinum
stages.summary: Vice Got a Price! unlocks with the 54th trophy. No online or DLC trophies are involved; one playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earned automatically with the last of the other 54 trophies. PowerPyx counts no online and no DLC trophies, rates the list 4/10 and puts the full run near 200 hours in a single playthrough. Follow the roadmap tab in order and the only thing to watch is the Chapter 1 meditation.
steps: Strangers & Freaks and feats clean-up (≈10 h)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening main mission of Chapter 1, so this is the first trophy almost everyone sees; it cannot be skipped. PowerPyx lists it as automatic.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. According to PowerPyx it pops once you clear the first main mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?). Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) and make a manual save.
steps: Meditate with Lucia at Jason's house first
Save, then play on into Chapter 2

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx reports it unlocks after the opening main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. By then Coffee Break has opened partner free-roam, so the partner trophies are already available.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx says it lands after the first two Chapter 4 main missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where Andy, Randy, Tyrone and Yasmani's jobs appear, so start those questlines before you push on.
steps: Play Ocean Beach and Another Life

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx ties it to the closing main mission Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 also offers the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which opens bank vault robberies: take it when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story gold. Finish the final main mission and it unlocks; PowerPyx names Starting From Zero as the mission. Free-roam continues after the credits, and the 100% checklist only becomes visible from that point (CryptoGames notes some lists word this as Chapter 5).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy earned during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run, per PowerPyx. Nothing optional is attached to it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist (PowerPyx). It cannot be failed into a lockout; retry from the checkpoint if things go wrong.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx places Child's Play among the Chapter 4 main missions; the trophy comes as it ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners, as listed by PowerPyx. Automatic.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown (PowerPyx). Not to be confused with Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam airport jet theft.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx lists Operation Savage Glory as a Chapter 5 main mission; it unlocks during it.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, but a lenient one: PowerPyx and GTABase both say nothing on the checklist is missable and that it equals roughly 60% of true completion. Story progress already counts. Clear any 100 optional missions as they appear, scan 200 base-model vehicles with WAiNK and study 100 animals through binoculars (no hunting needed). Robberies, underwater discoveries, the 42 shooting-range golds, the 42 drone time trials and Bret's 15 Target Decks are the parts you need in full.
steps: All robberies, shooting ranges, drone trials, Target Decks
70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixed freely across four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. PowerPyx finds flying under bridges the quickest. A stunt counts after one clean run; its optional challenges are not needed. 100% wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.
steps: Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists found and done stunts
Progress > Activities > Stunts shows progress by region
Farm Under the Bridges in an aircraft

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a win in a car race, race challenge or drone race, and one stunt. PowerPyx notes most are introduced by the story and the rest show as blue dumbbell icons on the map, so the 100% run covers them anyway.
steps: Touchpad > Progress > Activities shows which you have done

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.unlock: Buy a $5 waiver at each range
trophies.guide: 42 gold medals from 12 challenges at two ranges. Griffin Shooting Range (north-west Vice City) runs six moving courses with three gold tiers each (18); Rodgers Ranch (north-east of Port Gellhorn) runs six standing score challenges with four tiers each (24). Pay the clerk $5 for a waiver pass to make the challenges appear; GTADB reports a $10 rental if you lack the needed gun. Ranges also raise your Focus stat, which helps Gunslinger.
steps: Buy the waiver pass from each clerk
Gold every tier: Griffin 18, Rodgers Ranch 24
Track under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 Top Fun locations with 3 drone trials each, 42 in all (PowerPyx). For the trophy, win at every location; the 100% checklist wants all 42 trials. The 100% guides report that beating par in the first two trials of a spot unlocks the third, which you only need to finish.
steps: Win once at each of the 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: There are 40 unique races, shown as blue icons once you are within about 100 m. Win any 20 different ones for the trophy; 100% asks for 30, plus gold in 10 of the 13 separate Race Challenges. Yago's Strangers & Freaks strand also starts from a street race.
steps: Map > Activities > Racing to find them
Progress > Activities > Racing to count wins

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and a purple fishing marker appears on the map. Follow his fishing questline until you win one of his challenges (PowerPyx).
steps: Wait for Cal's text; go to the purple marker

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four video games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (playable from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around the map. Reach the end of any one of them; side challenges are optional. The TV is sometimes off-limits during story parts but returns after the story (PowerPyx).
steps: Use the controllers by the TV at home
Clear every level of one game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy phones Lucia and texts her address, marking the strand in Belville. PowerPyx lists five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass, the last one giving the trophy. Still open after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call
Finish all five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. His strand is treasure diving: he marks purple chests on the map, you recover the wrecks' loot (a metal detector helps on the sea floor) and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks complete it. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, so he is not missable (PowerPyx).
steps: Track via Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand appears at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. PowerPyx lists five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes, which ends the strand. Available after the story too.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only true Strangers & Freaks count; PowerPyx stresses that named contacts such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed strands so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (plane deliveries), with more still being found. They are not on the 100% list and remain after the story. CryptoGames relays a single-source warning that some chains have story-tied windows, so start them when you see them.
steps: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete confirmed
Find four more in the open world
Counter shows in the PlayStation trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also hands you the Key Cloner and delivers the first car. He then wants 16 high-end sports cars. Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list, steal them anywhere and drive them to his RK garage in west Vice City; clean cars pay more. PowerPyx finds many around the hotels of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
steps: Scan and steal the listed cars

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.unlock: After Here, Kitty Kitty (Ch3), Jason only
trophies.guide: Jason-only strand opened by the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show synthetic labs around Vice City; destroying them is the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs, Tyrone offers Spin On This, which awards the trophy (PowerPyx). Still there after the credits.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.window: Chapter 1 only: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house
trophies.guide: The only possibly missable trophy. PowerPyx counts 18 meditation spots at 10 places; meditating as both Jason and Lucia adds two at once. The first meditation happens only in Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It raises the counter but is not marked as a spot, and nobody has confirmed whether it is required, so do it. The last spot needs both characters together (after Coffee Break, Ch2).
steps: Ch1: kitchen chat with Lucia, then balcony, accept
Do each spot with both characters

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason after Coffee Break and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His strand asks for specific animals at purple hunting spots; he gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle (kept in Ammu-Nation lockers). Which unique animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%, so you will reach it (PowerPyx, CryptoGames).
steps: Clear the decks until it pops

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The 100% guides count 480 cards spread over 18 sets. Any three finished sets give the trophy; 100% wants 15 of 18, so pick the three sets nearest completion first. PowerPyx notes a few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that close, but they respawn elsewhere and do not block trophies.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Point the WAiNK phone app at scannable objects (hold Up, then R1). PowerPyx lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than 100 and any mix counts. The 100% checklist also asks for 100 WAiNK locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in eight categories of ten. The trophy wants 50 and 100% wants 70, so you can skip the ten nastiest. PowerPyx suggests leaving it near the end: by then many are already done through other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs partner free-roam, which opens with Coffee Break in Chapter 2; call your partner with Right (hold) and Triangle. Raise four stars, then flee on a fast motorbike. PowerPyx's easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter lose you. It counts once you leave the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies give four stars anyway, so it usually comes naturally.
steps: Escape through the Ambrosia rail tunnel

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.unlock: After Coffee Break (Ch2); jewelry stores after Ch3
trophies.guide: With your partner along, hit three green robbery icons in a row while the flashing police search never ends. PowerPyx recommends the three jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Ch3): grab several items in each and crack the back safe with sticky bombs. Bring armor and healing. The pop is delayed about half a minute; if it does not come, rob a fourth shop.
steps: Rob 3 shops without losing the stars

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning is enough; you do not have to drive anything. Stand at a busy road, hold Up for WAiNK and R1 on each new model. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch; 100% needs 200 base models, so this comes on the way. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.unlock: Any time; easier at Focus level 4
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming and only lasts seconds. Top up Focus first (food, drinks, a shower at home) and pop Adrenaline to stretch it. Pick a gang operation full of criminals; PowerPyx reports soldiers, cops and civilians do not seem to count. An accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 plus body armor works best. Ranges, golf, pool and fishing raise Focus over time.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International (planes parked out on the field do not count). PowerPyx's pick is the one at departure gates E3/E4: drive through the perimeter fence, take the stairs beside the bridge into the plane, go up to the cockpit, back out to the runway, take off and fly roughly 1 km away until it pops.
steps: Board the jet at gates E3/E4

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx and GTABase (via CryptoGames) point to Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where tanks stand on the south side. Ram the gate or use the stunt ramp by the south-east entrance, climb in and blast a few enemies until it unlocks.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station
Enter a tank on the south side

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) give you the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry store robberies. Enter by the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (kicking trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe unseen. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Snap Gun on the back door
Loot the safe without being spotted

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.unlock: After That's Where The Money Is… (Ch4 optional)
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… teaches vault jobs: tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault stands open. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hand off a bag. Afterwards Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 (after his two Payday Loans jobs). Vaults bring four stars instantly; a fast bike and a car swap shake them. 5 of 8 for the trophy, all 8 for 100%, up to $205,000 each (PowerPyx).
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is…
Rob 5 of the 8 large banks and escape

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.unlock: Ch4 vault mission, or earlier on the street
trophies.guide: PowerPyx says a large bank vault job counts as robbing the armored truck, so That's Where The Money Is… (Ch4) usually awards it. Earlier, you can box in an armored truck near a Vice City bank, put a sticky bomb on the rear doors and blow it (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs). It only pops once you clear the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear every patch of black fog from the map. PowerPyx and CryptoGames agree a plane is quickest: fly back and forth over the dark areas until the whole map is revealed. The starter list counts 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations, shown as yellow icons when you get close (many are marked by the story). One per gang earns the trophy; 100% wants all 39. Progress > Gangs shows how many of each gang's operations you have hit (PowerPyx).
steps: Hit one operation of each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not solved yet: PowerPyx lists it as unknown and KeenGamer says the trigger is still being confirmed. Going only by the official description, look for a bar or terrace with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City and order a cocktail there. No source reports it as missable.
steps: Visit Ocean Beach (Chapter 4 opens with a mission of that name)
Order a cocktail at a spot with a view

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. GTABase (quoted by CryptoGames) and Of Zen and Computing both suggest getting into a car inside a vehicle showroom and driving it out through the front window. PowerPyx still lists it as unknown.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.unlock: Ch2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Kolt gang operation, marked during Chapter 2 as the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (bring sticky bombs). It pops after you lose the police. If you miss an item, return when the robbery respawns (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat of Jason and Lucia at the same time (PowerPyx; GTABase via CryptoGames agrees). Buy a fitness club membership and always train together: while you work out with one, the other trains automatically, so both gain. Gyms show under Map > Activities; after the story you can also train at home.
steps: Work out together at a gym
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile; the PlayStation tracker shows the count. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to see each one. Stealthy jobs, non-lethal takedowns and violence all count, so it fills passively. PowerPyx warns that the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police harsher.
steps: Play normally; robberies and fights add up

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unsolved at launch. PowerPyx only offers a hunch that it is linked to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; CryptoGames lists it as unconfirmed. Going by the description, try repeating a robbery that went wrong the first time. Treat this as speculation until a guide confirms it.
steps: Revisit the prologue Payday Loans store (hunch)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unsolved at launch. PowerPyx believes it belongs to a UFO questline and GTABase (via CryptoGames) to a strange event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out for odd encounters; nothing more specific has been published.
steps: Watch for UFO or other strange events (unconfirmed)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. PowerPyx's guess is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle; Of Zen and Computing words it as downing a target with a melee drive-by. Try knocking several people over in one pass from a bike.
steps: Use the melee attack on pedestrians or enemies as you pass

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check gives you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The $250,000 adds up across many deliveries, and a single bank vault can bring up to $205,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total across every shop type. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so they get you there fastest (PowerPyx). Shop types include mod shops, Pay 'n' Spray, Ammu-Nation, clothing, footwear, salons, tattoo studios and electronics.
steps: Spend on weapons and car mods

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver the Vice City Real Estate app arrives on your phone. Buy all 8 purchasable garages there, about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count (PowerPyx, CryptoGames). Robberies from Chapters 3–4 fund it quickly.
steps: Open Vice City Real Estate on the phone

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app comes with the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register; from Chapter 3 cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low (PowerPyx).
